title: Space Race & Space Junk (Space Debris)
definition: The Space Race represents historical and contemporary geopolitical competition for supremacy in space exploration, while Space Junk (orbital debris) encompasses all defunct, non-functional human-made objects orbiting Earth that pose severe catastrophic hazards to active satellites and crewed spacecraft.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper-III (Science & Technology - space technology, security, international relations, environment). Highly tested in Prelims regarding Low Earth Orbit (LEO) congestion, Kessler Syndrome, mitigation guidelines, and India's debris tracking initiatives.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Space Race dynamics and Space Junk accumulation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, orbit types (LEO, MEO, GEO), institutional frameworks, and international space policies.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding debris mitigation and space law.
